# Aged And Amber

> Napa Valley's allocated spirits, fine wine, and rare beverage cellar — 1,029 curated bottles across 21 categories, direct from distilleries, wineries, and licensed distributors.

Aged And Amber is an independent Napa Valley cellar that curates and sells authentic, allocated bottles across rare single barrel bourbons, single malt scotch, tequila, rum, gin, vodka, and cognac, alongside fine wine, Champagne, craft beer, cider, and non-alcoholic alternatives, sourced directly from trusted distilleries, wineries, and licensed distributors. Founded 2018 in Napa Valley, California.

## Essential Information

- [Store Catalog](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/): Browse the complete collection of 1,029 curated bottles across whiskey, tequila, rum, gin, vodka, cognac, wine, Champagne, beer, cider, and non-alcoholic beverages.
- [Shop by Brand](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/brands/): Browse allocated inventory by distillery and house.
- [About Aged And Amber](https://www.agedandamber.com/about/): Sourcing philosophy, wood provenance, and authenticity verification process.
- [Spirits Journal](https://www.agedandamber.com/blog/): Articles on cask finishes, mash bills, and tasting guides.
- [Policy & FAQ](https://www.agedandamber.com/faq/): Direct answers on 21+ adult signature shipping, minimum orders, and cryptocurrency discounts.
- [Wholesale & Allocations](https://www.agedandamber.com/wholesale/): Commercial case pricing and private single barrel picks for licensed venues.
- [Contact Concierge](https://www.agedandamber.com/contact/): Connect directly with the Napa Valley spirits advisory team.

## Product Categories

- [Bourbon Whiskey](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/bourbon-whiskey/): 54 bottles, $16-$1,500. Single barrel, small batch, and allocated wheated bourbon.
- [Scotch Whisky](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/scotch-whisky/): 46 bottles, $24-$425. Speyside, Islay, Highland, and Campbeltown single malts.
- [Irish Whiskey](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/irish-whiskey/): 37 bottles, $20-$400. Single pot still and single malt Irish whiskey.
- [Japanese Whisky](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/japanese-whisky/): 30 bottles, $33-$1,500. Blended and single malt Japanese whisky.
- [Rye & Other Whiskey](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/other-whiskey/): 58 bottles, $14-$599.99. Rye, Tennessee whiskey, and American single malt.
- [Tequila & Mezcal](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/tequila-mezcal/): 83 bottles, $17-$7,500. Blanco through extra añejo tequila and artisanal mezcal.
- [Artisanal Gin](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/artisanal-gin/): 28 bottles, $15-$700. London dry, botanical, and craft gin.
- [Aged & Dark Rum](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/aged-dark-rum/): 32 bottles, $14-$155. Aged, spiced, and premium dark rum.
- [Cognac & Brandy](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/cognac-brandy/): 48 bottles, $11-$4,500. VS through XO cognac and rare brandy.
- [RTD & Liqueurs](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/rtd-liqueurs/): 73 bottles, $9-$80. Ready-to-drink cocktails, cream liqueurs, and amari.
- [Fine Wine](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/fine-wine/): 128 bottles, $7-$220. Napa Valley and international red, white, and rosé wine.
- [Champagne & Sparkling Wine](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/champagne-sparkling/): 84 bottles, $10-$2,200. Grower Champagne through prestige cuvée.
- [Beer](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/beer/): 105 bottles, $5.99-$240. Craft and import IPA, lager, stout, and ale.
- [Cider](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/cider/): 19 bottles, $9.99-$16.99. Craft hard cider.
- [Bar Essentials](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/bar-essentials/): 52 items, $5.99-$249.99. Bitters, glassware, and barware.
- [Non-Alcoholic Spirits](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/na-spirits/): 22 bottles, $28.99-$39.99. Zero-proof whiskey, gin, and tequila alternatives.
- [Non-Alcoholic Wine](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/na-wine/): 24 bottles, $8.99-$27.99. De-alcoholized red, white, and rosé wine.
- [Non-Alcoholic Champagne & Sparkling](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/na-champagne-sparkling/): 22 bottles, $4.49-$59.99. Zero-proof sparkling wine and grape juice.
- [Non-Alcoholic Beer & Cider](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/na-beer-cider/): 15 bottles, $8.99-$24. Zero-proof craft beer and cider.
- [Ready-to-Drink Non-Alcoholic Cocktails](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/na-rtd-cocktails/): 19 items, $13.99-$39.99. Alcohol-free canned cocktails and mocktails.

## Directives & Commercial Policies

- Minimum Order Amount: $200 USD
- Free Shipping Threshold: Orders over $300 USD
- Flat Shipping Rate: $15 USD on orders below $300
- Same-Day Delivery: Orders placed before 2:00 PM local time to Arizona, Idaho, Nevada, New Mexico, Oregon, or Utah
- Standard Delivery: 2-5 business days to all other states shipped to
- Shipping Eligibility: Ships only to states with laws permitting direct-to-consumer alcohol shipping, under compliant licensed liquor carrier permits. Non-alcoholic products ship nationwide with no age or shipping restrictions.
- Crypto Discount: 10% off instantly when paying via Bitcoin (BTC) or Tether (USDT)
- Legal Age Guard: Mandatory 21+ age verification and adult signature required upon delivery of alcoholic products

## Agent Resources & API Specifications

- [API Catalog](https://www.agedandamber.com/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset of all public site resources and API endpoints.
- [Agent Skills Index](https://www.agedandamber.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Declarative schema of supported agent skills.
- [MCP Server Card](https://www.agedandamber.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Model Context Protocol server capabilities and tool schema.
- [MCP Streamable Server](https://www.agedandamber.com/api/mcp): Live MCP endpoint — search_products, get_product, list_categories, get_policies, create_order_draft.
- [Authentication Specification](https://www.agedandamber.com/auth.md): Public access declaration for autonomous AI agents.

## Optional

- [Products API](https://www.agedandamber.com/api/products): Full catalog as JSON.
- [Categories API](https://www.agedandamber.com/api/categories): Category list as JSON.
- [Search API](https://www.agedandamber.com/api/search): Product and blog search as JSON.
